what: What Claude Code and Codex CLI send a hook at session start and session end, from one recorded run of each in a scratch clone of the m2/slice-3 branch, for criteria 13 and 36 of the M2 plan. A second hook, given on the command line, appended each payload and the hook's parent processes; the clone's own wiring ran as committed. Paths are redacted.
setup: git clone --branch m2/slice-3 of this repository into /scratch/ws; git config core.hooksPath .githooks
docs/stale-for-the-record.md added, untracked, with last-reviewed 2020-01-01, so the stale-page notice has something to say

claude-code.command: claude -p "If your context names any page past its review date, reply with that page's path; otherwise reply: none" --model haiku --max-turns 1 --settings capture.json --output-format stream-json --verbose

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext:
These pages are past their review date. If you edit one, review the whole page first and move its last-reviewed date; the commit check refuses the edit otherwise:
- docs/stale-for-the-record.md

codex.note: Codex reported the project's own configuration as untrusted and did not load it, so the clone's .codex/hooks.json did not run; only the capture hook given on the command line did. The payloads below are what Codex sends any SessionStart and SessionEnd hook.
